summary: Tested Early Access VIP feature (backend flag + VIP Hub + VIP sales page in 3 languages) and Admin analytics quick-access button. Backend: 3/3 pytest cases pass — /api/vip/permissions returns early_access:true for VIP user (jcuradeau.7@gmail.com), early_access:false for a newly registered free user, and 401 without auth. Frontend: VIP Hub renders 6 feature cards including 'Early Access' with pink rocket icon (last card, bottom-right). VIP sales page renders 6 feature rows ending with 'Early Access / Be the first to test new Mentova features before everyone else' (English) — French/Spanish translations present in source (verified in code and rendered EN screen). Admin panel Users tab shows a purple analytics icon button next to each user row (19 buttons for 19 users). Real-click at coordinates navigated correctly to /user/intelligence?userId=<id> and the User Intelligence page loaded with Overview/Engagement/Atlas AI/Learning/Features/Revenue/Timeline sections + engagement score.

issues: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated → use 'boxShadow'; props.pointerEvents deprecated; Animated useNativeDriver not supported on web (pre-existing, cosmetic).

action_items: LOW: data-testid attributes on RN TouchableOpacity in admin.tsx (user-intel-{id}) and vip/hub.tsx (vip-hub-{key}) and vip/index.tsx (vip-feature-{i}) do not reach the DOM because React Native Web strips unknown props on custom RN components. Use the RN `testID` prop instead (RN Web maps testID → data-testid on the underlying View). This was flagged in iteration_94 for the intelligence page — same root cause. Purely a testability/reduced automation robustness issue; functionality is unaffected.

LOW/OPTIONAL: VIP Hub only shows 6 feature cards (Atlas Memory, Chart Analysis, Market Intelligence, Personalized Learning, Daily Briefing, Early Access) but the backend permissions payload lists 7 features (also `advanced_tools`). If Advanced Tools should be visible in the Hub (existing feature), add it. Otherwise ignore — matches E1's stated design ('6 feature cards including Early Access').
critical_code_review_comments: admin.tsx is 3102 lines — well above the 700-line maintainability threshold. Consider splitting into Users tab, Posts tab, Mentors tab, etc. sub-components.
vip/index.tsx: FEATURES object duplicates icon/color per language (6 features × 3 langs). Extract icon+color to a shared config and only localize title/desc — DRY improvement.

vip_permissions.py: hard-coded PLANS dict is fine; consider exposing FEATURE_KEYS constant so /api/vip/permissions response schema is data-driven and reduces drift risk when adding new features (7th flag was added in two places today).
